# PennyWise - Student Financial & Travel Operations Ledger

> High-performance financial ledger designed for students and travel tour operators with verified authentication, transaction logging, and real-time cash flow telemetry.

## Overview
PennyWise offers two dedicated financial workspace modes:
1. Student Financial Hub: Track allowances, semester fees, monthly spending targets, and category expenses.
2. Travel Company ERP: Manage group tour trips, passenger revenue, multi-vendor expenses, and commission accounting.

## API & Endpoints
- `/api/health`: Health status endpoint for operational monitoring.
- `/api/auth/login`: User and company admin authentication.
- `/api/auth/register-otp`: Email-verified account onboarding with 6-digit OTP.
- `/api/travel/dashboard`: Financial analytics, net income, and tour ledger summaries.

## Documentation Links
- [Application Web App](https://penny-wise-ashy.vercel.app/login): Production application login.
